content:
Footer

Configure footer text that appears at the bottom of debit notes.

Use footers to add terms, conditions, or additional information to debit notes.

Name

Enter a name to identify this footer. This name will appear in dropdown menus when selecting a footer for debit notes.

Content

Enter the content that will appear at the bottom of debit notes. You can include multiple lines of text, contact details, or any other information.

Inactive

Mark this footer as inactive to prevent it from appearing in footer selection dropdowns. Existing debit notes using this footer will not be affected.
